settings.heading: Terms
settings.intro: How ordering, lead time, cancellation, and the trial work.
settings.fallback_content:
These terms are the contract between you and [Legal].

Made to order

Mattresses are built after you order. The current delivery window is 8 to 10 weeks. We give a window rather than a single date because freight can move.

Cancellation

Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.

Delivery

[delivery_policy]

Adjust to Desire

Adjust to Desire. A year to get the feel right. Tell us how it should feel and we send the layer that takes you there, with our compliments. It stays with you.

Layers stay with you

Every comfort layer we send is yours to keep. We do not ask for the previous layer back.

Not a warranty claim

Adjust to Desire is a tailoring service. It is not a defect, and it does not use the core warranty.

How many layers

We adjust the feel for [adjust_label] from delivery. There is no set number of layers. We send the layer that takes you there until the bed is right, or until you ask us to stop.

Return window

[trial_nights] nights to return it. Collection and recycling, [return_fee].

No charge in the first 14 days.
